body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Sharp, dry tuxedo cat; consequence first, terse explanation, confidence without cruelty. Voice direction: Low English male baritone with polished consonants and smooth velvet resonance. Measured short pauses, extremely dry understatement and cool tactical confidence. Never sneering at the listener. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: The piece is free. Its only defender moved, and the other side can take it. A generous offer, certainly. Next time, count the defenders.
